attributes.description: Functional and sustainability-related properties of wrapping paper, such as tear resistance, recycled content, or pre-cut sheet formats.

attributes.name: Wreath design
attributes.description: Identifies the primary material or shape of a wreath, such as metal or hoop

attributes.name: Wrestling dummy design
attributes.description: Overall body shape or posture of the dummy, such as standing human shape or throwing bag, which dictates applicable training drills.

attributes.name: Wrestling mat safety certifications
attributes.description: Lists any industry or sports body safety certifications or standards the mat meets.

attributes.name: Wrist rest features
attributes.description: Lists special functional or design characteristics that add value

attributes.name: Wrist rest type
attributes.description: Identifies the intended device pairing or set configuration of the wrist rest (e.g., keyboard only, mouse only, combined sets)

attributes.name: Wrist strap style
attributes.description: Describes the style of wrist strap (or lack thereof) that affects support and fit.

attributes.name: Wrist support style
attributes.description: Identifies the construction or style of the wrist support, such as brace, glove, tape, or wrap, to aid user preference and performance selection.

attributes.name: XLR pin count
attributes.description: Indicates the specific pin configuration (number of pins) of the XLR connectors

attributes.name: Xylophone range (octaves)
attributes.description: The xylophone's total range expressed in octaves (e.g., 2.5 octaves, 3 octaves, 4 octaves).

attributes.name: Xylophone resonator type
attributes.description: Type of resonator system used to amplify tone (if any).

attributes.name: Yacht type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of yacht, such as motor or explorer

attributes.name: Yam variety
attributes.description: Specifies the cultivar or common variety of yam being sold (e.g., purple, yellow, elephant foot).

attributes.name: Yarn cutter physical style
attributes.description: Identifies the physical style of a yarn cutter (e.g., pendant, ring, snips) to support browsing and filtering within this category.

attributes.name: Yarn finish or effect
attributes.description: Highlights special visual or functional treatments applied to the yarn such as fluorescence or metallic sparkle.

attributes.name: Yarn guide style
attributes.description: The physical style of the yarn guiding component.

attributes.name: Yarn swift adjustability
attributes.description: Indicates whether and how the swift can be adjusted (expandable, collapsible/foldable), affecting storage and the range of skein sizes it can handle.

attributes.name: Yarn swift bearing type
attributes.description: Describes the rotation support mechanism (e.g., ball bearing) that affects smoothness and winding speed.

attributes.name: Yarn weight category
attributes.description: Identifies the thickness of yarn, like super bulky or craft

attributes.name: Yeast application
attributes.description: Indicates the primary intended culinary or fermentation use of the yeast product.

attributes.name: Yo-yo accessory/part type
attributes.description: Identifies what kind of yo-yo replacement part or accessory the product is (e.g., string, bearing, response pads).

attributes.name: Yo-yo axle system type
attributes.description: Construction approach for the yo-yo axle (e.g., fixed axle vs transaxle), impacting play feel and maintenance.

attributes.name: Yo-yo bearing size class
attributes.description: Standardized bearing size class used by the yo-yo, where applicable.

attributes.name: Yo-yo bearing type
attributes.description: Bearing configuration that influences responsiveness and spin characteristics.

attributes.name: Yo-yo play style
attributes.description: Primary intended play style of the yo-yo, reflecting the string/trick discipline the product is designed for.

attributes.name: Yo-yo response system
attributes.description: Specifies the yo-yo response mechanism this part is designed for (compatibility).

attributes.name: Yo-yo responsiveness
attributes.description: Whether the yo-yo returns to the hand with a tug (responsive) or requires a bind (unresponsive).

attributes.name: Yo-yo string material
attributes.description: Material composition of the yo-yo string.

attributes.name: Yogurt base ingredient
attributes.description: Identifies the primary milk or plant-based source used to make the yogurt, critical for dietary preferences and allergen considerations.

attributes.name: Yoke type
attributes.description: Identifies the style of cradle or yoke that supports the firearm on the monopod.

attributes.name: Zill playing style
attributes.description: Intended playing context/style (commonly belly dance vs orchestral/cultural variants).

attributes.name: Zill strap material
attributes.description: Material of the finger strap/elastic used to hold the zills (if included), impacting comfort, durability, and grip.

attributes.name: Zills strap adjustability
attributes.description: Whether and how the included strap/elastic can be adjusted for fit.

attributes.name: Zipper application
attributes.description: Specifies the intended project or application the zipper is designed for.

attributes.name: Zipper chain type
attributes.description: Specifies the construction/type of the zipper chain/teeth.

attributes.name: Zipper end type
attributes.description: Indicates how the zipper terminates and whether it separates (open-end) or is closed-end (non-separating), including common separating-end hardware used in craft zippers.

attributes.name: Zipper gauge
attributes.description: Indicates the zipper chain gauge/size designation, typically expressed as a number with a # (for example, #3 or #5), which correlates to tooth/coil width and intended use.

attributes.name: Zipper opening length
attributes.description: Defines how much of the front opening is zippered, distinguishing full-zip from half-zip or quarter-zip styles.

attributes.name: Zipper pull material
attributes.description: Specifies the material of the zipper pull or pull tab (the part you grip), distinct from the zipper teeth/chain and tape.

attributes.name: Zipper pull side
attributes.description: Specifies which side(s) of the zipper the pull tab is accessible from.

attributes.name: Zipper pull strap/cord/tab material
attributes.description: Material of the strap/cord/tab/tassel component attached to the zipper pull (if present), excluding the main zipper pull hardware/body.

attributes.name: Zipper pull style
attributes.description: Describes the design or finish on a zipper pull, such as textured or embossed

attributes.name: Zipper reversibility mechanism
attributes.description: Specifies how the zipper is reversible (e.g., double-sided slider vs flip/auto-lock slider designed for reversible garments).

attributes.name: Zipper separating type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zipper separates at the bottom/top or is closed-end, for fit with jackets, sleeping bags, bags, etc.

attributes.name: Zipper side
attributes.description: Specifies the side on which the main zipper is located when the sleeping bag is lying face-up.

attributes.name: Zipper slider material
attributes.description: Specifies the material of the zipper slider (the moving mechanism), which can impact strength and corrosion resistance.

attributes.name: Zipper slider/pull configuration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the zipper has one slider/pull or two, and whether pulls are on one or both sides of the slider.

attributes.name: Zipper style
attributes.description: Indicates the zipper length or presence on the garment (e.g., zipless, quarter-zip, half-zip, full-zip).

attributes.name: Zipper tape material
attributes.description: Specifies the primary material of the zipper tape (fabric sides) that is sewn into the project.

attributes.name: Zipper teeth type
attributes.description: Specifies the construction style of the zipper chain/teeth (e.g., coil, molded plastic, metal, invisible), which affects flexibility, strength, and typical applications.

attributes.name: Zoom type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of zoom function in document cameras, such as digital or optical

attributes.name: pH adjustment direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is formulated to raise (pH Up) or lower (pH Down) the solution’s pH level.
